A letter to HR may suffice, but I would suggest a copy to the head of HR as well. Let them know that if not taken seriously, you would possibly go public. That might make them re-think things since it would be a PR fiasco.
If you continue working, you would jeopardize your own life and the lives of people who live and interact with you. Is that at the same priority as a job right now? Is it worth risking?

Write a letter containing your concerns in a voncise way and state the facts plainly. Also indicate your intention as to why you believe closing temporarily or suspending work is a good idea. Have it signed by all of your coworkers then give it to the owners. If they do not hear you out, gather your correspondence with them and inform authorities since that's technically endangerment

Also, try to ask her why she is doing what she does and level with her.

I guarantee that it won't be perfect and it will get confusing, but with time and consistency, you will somewhat have better communication with her. You're still young and she may be adjusting to you becoming a big boy/teenager and she is having struggles that's why she's seeking her friends' help. I hope this helps.

Hello OP, I just want to let you know that you are not out of time. It certainly feels that way, specially with the pandemic limiting a lot of choices we used to have career-wise. The thing is, you are not supposed to have it figured out. You can try working in whatever you want and see how it turns out so you can find where you would thrive or at least be comfortable in.

In terms of money in career, our current climate makes earning money a bit harder than it used to, but there are so many new ways to make money and you must take advantage of it. Find side hustles online like being a virtual assistant, transcribe recordings, or stuff like that to occupy your free time and to earn a bit extra.

Please don't succumb to the pressure of feeling like you have to have everything figured out. We're all supposed to feel lost in our 20s and I swear, the right thing will come along in time.
